name: Bonny's civil war and the founding of Opobo

summary.text: The rivalry between Bonny's two great trading houses, Oko Jumbo's Manilla Pepple and Jaja's Anna Pepple, revived after King George Pepple's accession. In 1869 they fought a major battle. Jaja led his house and followers 26 miles east to the mouth of the Imo river and founded Opobo, cutting Bonny off from the palm-oil markets of the Imo. Bonny turned on Kalabari's rivers to make up the loss.

moments.title: Battle of the houses
moments.text: The Anna Pepple house loses the battle in Bonny.

moments.title: Opobo founded
moments.text: Jaja founds his new town astride the Imo trade.
